messages:
Nina (CSM): Kicking off Coriolis onboarding. Quick list: API integration, SSO, p95 latency target < 300ms, relevance target +10% NDCG, and weekly pilot feedback. Who are owners on your side?
Sofia (Coriolis PM): Sofia here. I'll own product signoff. Rahul is infra. Add success metric: first-response correctness >= 92% on our test suite.
Rahul (Coriolis Infra): Rahul 0: OIDC: https://login.coriolis.com/. We'll need Redwood egress IPs and a short maintenance window for cutover.
Eddie (Solutions Eng): I'll lead the connector. Proposed sprint: week1 connector + SSO, week2 E2E smoke + latency bench, week3 relevance tuning + enablement. Need labeled prompts by day 7.
Nina (CSM): I'll send allowlist and set up a 5-question weekly Typeform for pilot feedback. Proposed workshops: Tech deep-dive Thu 10:00 PT, Prompts lab Mon 11:00 PT, Enablement Wed 14:00 PT.
DeployBot: created sandbox: coriolis-pilot-001 at 1765550050 (creds pending)
Eddie (Solutions Eng): Deploy noted. Question: enable KV/prefix caching during bench? My suggestion: OFF for initial 2 weeks to measure raw behavior.
Sofia (Coriolis PM): Agree caching off initially. We'll want recordings of enablement and a short playbook for support triage.
Nina (CSM): Actions: Nina->share allowlist + Typeform link; Eddie->post curl example + sandbox creds; Sofia->upload labeled eval set + SLAs; Rahul->confirm OIDC metadata + maintenance window. Renewal note: if pilot usage < 30% of expected by day 21 we flag for escalation.
Eddie (Solutions Eng): Curl example I'm putting in the shared doc:
curl -X POST https://sbx.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CORIOLIS_SBX" \
  -d '{"input":"Extract total from invoice #A123"}'
Sofia (Coriolis PM): We'll aim to deliver the labeled set by EOD Fri. Thanks everyone, looking forward to kickoff.
Nina (CSM): Thanks 0I'll follow up with invites and the acceptance criteria doc link here. :thumbsup:
